Package neqsim.thermo.characterization

Class RefineryHydrotreatingHydrogenRecycleBalance

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.characterization.RefineryHydrotreatingHydrogenRecycleBalance
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RefineryHydrotreatingHydrogenRecycleBalance extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable steady-state hydrogen recycle and purge receipt for a hydrotreating screening case.

The calculation composes a RefineryHydrotreatingHydrogenSupplyBalance with explicit component recovery and common purge assumptions. It is a component balance, not a separator, phase-equilibrium, compressor, reactor, or catalyst model.

Version:
1.0
Author:
esolbr1

    • calculate

      public static RefineryHydrotreatingHydrogenRecycleBalance calculate(RefineryHydrotreatingHydrogenSupplyBalance supplyBalance, double hydrogenRecoveryFraction, double hydrogenSulfideRecoveryFraction, double nonHydrogenRecoveryFraction, double purgeFraction)
      Calculate a steady-state component recycle and purge balance.
      Parameters:
      supplyBalance - qualified once-through hydrogen-supply receipt
      hydrogenRecoveryFraction - fraction of reactor-outlet H2 recovered before purge
      hydrogenSulfideRecoveryFraction - fraction of reactor-outlet H2S recovered before purge
      nonHydrogenRecoveryFraction - fraction of reactor-outlet non-H2 recovered before purge
      purgeFraction - fraction of each recovered component purged instead of recycled
      Returns:
      immutable recycle and purge receipt
